title: The Forge Bell
text: An iron bell that once called a thousand smiths to work hangs over the ruined gate, silent for an age. Its rope is still there, frayed to threads. Rust weeps from its lip like tears. Some say the smiths still answer it.

options.label: Ring the old forge bell, and see whether the smiths still answer.

outcomes.text: The ghosts of the smiths rise silent and grey to work, making you something. They do not stop when you leave.
Something else rises to the call. It is not a smith.

options.label: The strongest takes the bell for its metal. It has rung its last.

outcomes.text: The bell is heavy and worth it. Afterward the halls are very quiet, as if something has been lost.

options.label: Leave it silent. Some calls should not be made.

outcomes.text: The rope sways as you pass. Deep in the halls a hammer starts up anyway; the Leader's armour rings in answer, and by morning its dents are gone.

options.label: The one in plate rings it, and lets the old hammers hear the call of iron.

outcomes.text: The bell's voice passes through the halls and through the plate. Every hammer in the dark answers, and by morning the plate is better than its maker left it.
